g.text: Each machine is normalised to its own specification. Points below the line stream the whole weight file per token. Most points above it read only part

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #7b8794

g.text: of their file by design. One does not: the hollow dense point at 105.7% cannot exceed a ceiling it must stream under, so its excess measures the error

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #7b8794

g.text: in this proxy. On-disk size stands in for per-token traffic; it is not a measurement of it, and hollow markers are builds whose weights are not

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #7b8794
